untrained_sanity.note: untrained mean CE need not equal ln(V) exactly — the embed*sqrt(d) init scale inflates it; the equality checked is production-path vs independent recomputation.

step1_loss_explanation: Observed step-1 loss ~38.7 vs ln(32000)=10.37: the forward pass scales embeddings by sqrt(d_model) (Transformer convention) and norm_first encoder blocks apply no final LayerNorm before the head, so initial logits have std >> 1 and initial CE exceeds ln(V). Identical across arms; converges under training; not a mis-normalization of the loss.
